reason: RapidPay embedded-checkout SDK wired as active gateway. Merchant API contract documented and implemented (OAuth2 token endpoint, /v1/checkout-sessions, X-RapidGateway-Signature webhook signing). Set contractVerified: true only after a full end-to-end checkout is tested in TEST mode (use test credentials: client/secret, amount 100=success) and payment, webhook delivery, booking finalization, and the confirm-poll path are all verified. Required env vars: RAPIDPAY_API_KEY (client secret), RAPIDPAY_MERCHANT_ID (1442), RAPIDPAY_BASE_URL (https://secure.rapid-gateway.com), RAPIDPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
